one_line: Show the finished item on a real bag first, then each step with a short line, and ask to save.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 handheld shot of a girl's back on a floral backpack, a blue bunny keychain on it; a logo at the top. Text: "הכירו את השירנקיט - דפי פלסטיק שיוצרים קסמים ✨". Voice: "בואו נכין יצירה מהממת".
q1_hook.why: A finished, charming result on a real school bag in frame one, with a headline naming the product at once (H1, H2, T3), and voice and text together (H6). The result is shown before the steps and the expert's role is on screen (S6). Logo and headline stack in the top third (T4).

beats.what: Keychain on a backpack; headline and logo; "ונקשט איתה את הילקוטים"
beats.why: The result first, with a named product

beats.what: Hand traces a bunny page under a clear sheet; "נעתיק וכך נתרגל גם דיוק"
Colouring with pencils; "נצבע בצבעי עפרון,"; the voice names the pencil brand (transcript)
A child cuts the shape with scissors; the voice calls it more practice in precision (transcript)
A hole punch; the piece goes into an oven; a caution box "כמובן ששומרים על כללי הזהירות"
beats.why: Steps 4 and 5, with a safety line

beats.what: Oven window; "שמרו לכם את ההוראות" with a save icon
beats.why: The save ask while the piece bakes

beats.what: Shrunken piece beside its printout; "ותראו כמה שהוא התכווץ"; a keyring is threaded
beats.why: The payoff, the shrinking, shown close

beats.what: Keychain on the bag; "חותמת לכם שהילדים פשוט יעופו על זה"; "מוזמנים לעקוב"
beats.why: Back to the opening picture, with a follow ask

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: On screen at 0:25: "שמרו לכם את ההוראות" with a save icon. At 0:36: a follow invitation. Caption: save the steps, and a story invitation. A step list is worth returning to.
q2_flow.why: A result first and a shrink reveal at 0:28 make a clear arc, with the last frame returning to the opening picture (R4, K2). A new step every 3 to 5 s keeps the middle moving (R3). A numbered step list is reusable and the save ask is placed mid-wait (R7, R5). It stops 1 s after the payoff (R1).

q3_cta.what: 0:25-0:27: "שמרו לכם את ההוראות" with a save icon. 0:36: "מוזמנים לעקוב לעוד המון פעילויות מפתחות". Caption: "שמרו לכם את ההוראות בסרטון, ובוא לסטורי לראות מה אני מכינה". No link.
q3_cta.why: The save ask is well placed after the steps and has a purpose, the instructions (R7, C2), but it is shown, not said. It is joined by a follow ask and a story invitation, three actions (C1). The caption repeats the save ask but not in its first line (C6).

q4_shown.what: A finished keychain on a backpack 0:00; hands tracing, colouring, cutting a clear sheet and punching a hole 0:04-0:22; the oven 0:23-0:27; the shrunken piece beside its printout 0:28; a keyring threaded 0:30; the keychain on the bag 0:32. A child's hands appear.
q4_shown.why: The result is shown first and the shrink is a visible before and after, though no principle in the list covers it. Hands-only steps carry the Reel (S4), a child's face is never shown (S5), and the OT credential is only a logo (S6).

q5_edit.what: 11 shots in 37 s, about 3.4 s each; hard cuts, one shot per step; time-lapse jumps through the craft. Subtitles in short chunks synced to the voiceover, a safety box at 0:23, a save icon at 0:25. Ends on the keychain in hand.
q5_edit.why: One cut per step keeps every shot new and short (E2, R3). Synced short subtitles carry the voice muted (E4). It starts and ends on the same picture, so it ends cleanly on the result (E8, R4).

q6_topic.what: How to make a heat-shrink bunny keychain for a school bag, by an occupational therapist, with the fine-motor benefit named. Serves parents looking for a craft with a child.
q6_topic.why: A practical craft with a pretty result, framed by an expert's modest benefit, "practising precision" (K4). It speaks to the back-to-school moment through the school bag (K7). A step list parents can save and send on (R5).

q7_filmed.what: Handheld top-down shots on a wooden table for the steps, with a child's hands; a handheld oven close-up; outdoor daylight on a girl's back and a backpack at the start and the end. Hand held to the camera for the keychain.
q7_filmed.why: Top-down hands show each step as the viewer would do it (F5), and the shapes fill the frame and stay readable (F4). Daylight and a home table look native (F7, H8). Subtitles and the logo sit in the top and bottom bands (F2).

q8_text.on_screen: A logo and "מיכל שטורם / מרפאה בעיסוק לילדים" at the top (0:00-0:03); headline "הכירו את השירנקיט - דפי פלסטיק שיוצרים קסמים ✨" mid-frame (0:00); white bold subtitles about 75% down in short chunks ("נעתיק וכך נתרגל גם דיוק" 0:08); a black caution box (0:23); "שמרו לכם את ההוראות" with a save icon mid-frame (0:25-0:27); "מוזמנים לעקוב לעוד המון פעילויות מפתחות" (0:36).
q8_text.caption: "גם בקליניקה וגם אצלי בבית, דפי השרינקיט של @superkitcraft הם להיט אמיתי." About 70 words: a benefit, a save ask, a story invitation, a signature, 4 hashtags. No disclosure words.
q8_text.why: A headline in the first second states the product (T3), and the step subtitles are short and held about 1 s (T1, T5), so a muted viewer can follow. Several elements stack in the top third at the start (T2, T4). The caption has professional keywords and 4 hashtags (T7); only a tag discloses (T8).

weak_points: Three asks at the end; a headline, logo and subtitle at once in 0:00-0:03; brand named only in passing and a caption tag; disclosure by tag only; a child's hands and a girl's back with a bag.
lumebook_takeaway: Open on the finished result, then one top-down shot per step with a 5-word subtitle, a mid-Reel save prompt, and the same shot to close.
not_verified: Whether the voice is the creator's. The price, and whether the post was paid beyond the tag and coauthor listing. Music is not evident. Whether the sheets' brand shows on the packaging (not visible). Correction to src/coded: the first shot is a girl's back, not just a keychain, and her face is not shown. Lead edit 18 Oct: resolution remarks removed, because the downloaded copy can be smaller than what was posted.
